entries.text: I'm an aerospace engineering student. I'm on North Campus four days a week and Central Campus twice a week. I bike everywhere and don't have a car. I cook a lot, so I want a big kitchen, a dishwasher and in-unit laundry. I need a quiet place to live, and my budget is $1,100 a month.
